name: PITAPATA
description: PITAPATA is a character brand centered around making collectible chibi-style avatars inspired by YouTubers and creators within the inZOI community. Explore playful, stylized miniature characters with oversized heads and simple outfits with recognizable traits that reflect each creator’s identity.
highlights: Influencers and Creators from the inZOI Community
installation: PITAPATA pieces are character-brand collectibles rather than standard furniture, so where each one appears can vary. Check Build Mode's Decor category first; if a specific creator avatar was packaged as a wearable or Create-a-Zoi asset instead, it will show up in that menu rather than Build Mode. Search "PITAPATA" in either menu if you are not sure where a specific piece landed.
